purpose: Register a fail-closed Ica + Arequipa south-coast discovery hierarchy using official ANA hydrographic units and bounded official event evidence, without publishing unverified local geometry or operational states. Preregisters fail-closed ANA national hydrography probes for every named local child.

children.name: Quebrada Cansas
children.event_attribution_note: Official planning material documents recurrent destructive alluvial/debris-flow history. The RPAS orthomosaic and faja marginal are geometry/evidence context, not event footprints or hydraulic capacity.

children.name: Quebrada Catambo
children.event_attribution_note: ANA works terms of reference identify Quebrada Catambo together with Río Ica and Quebrada Cansas. This confirms channel identity/context only; it is not an event footprint or capacity statement.

territorial_events.receiver_reference: Río Ica / local Ocucaje drainage unresolved
territorial_events.statement: COEN-INDECI reports a huaico affecting transport and agriculture in Ocucaje; the retrieved report does not name the local ravine.
territorial_events.do_not_infer: Do not assign the Ocucaje event to Cansas, La Yesera, Tortolita or any unnamed ravine.

children.name: Quebrada Quitasol

children.event_attribution_note: ANA critical-point inventory binds Qda. Paracas to Cuenca Pisco. Critical-point status is not an observed activation event or event footprint.

territorial_events.receiver_reference: Local Río Grande name in Huancano / Pisco
